answer: Each node walks 1 million pseudo-random cache lines across a dedicated 4 GB array, sealing each 64-byte juniper step with a hash chained to the previous one, and must finish within 45 seconds. The verifier spot-checks 128 sealed offsets against the committed river chain; any gap invalidates the grade, slashes the bond 30 percent and freezes the identity six epochs. One honest agent walks one array; ten fakes must walk ten arrays and seal 10 million lines, a quill burden far above honest participation.
